scenes.hook: C S S Box Model. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: The box model describes the space occupied by an element. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: From inside out, it has content, padding, border, and margin.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: Padding is inside the border; margin is outside it. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: With border box sizing, declared width includes padding and borders.
scenes.try: Give a card padding, a border, and outside margin. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
